subject: Pricing inventory request — per-1M IO split + supported models
body:
--- Message 1 (original inbound) ---
From: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@clearpathhealth.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing inquiry — tokens, IO split and model roster

Hi Ben,

We are evaluating hosted inference options for two pilot products and need a quick baseline to compare unit economics. Can you send your standard per-1M token rates (please break out input vs output) and a short list of supported models for hosted API (indicate which are recommended for production latency-sensitive features)?

Current constraints: HIPAA-ish data (PHI redaction planned), typical prompt length ~350 tokens, average generated output ~220 tokens.

Also curious if you have a one-pager or ratecard PDF we can share internally.

Thanks,
Sylvia Kim
Director, Product
ClearPath Health
sylvia.kim@clearpathhealth.com

--- Message 2 (reply) ---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing inquiry — tokens, IO split and model roster

Hi Sylvia — thanks for the short brief. Attaching a baseline ratecard PDF and a simple commit-tier workbook. Below is a concise summary to get you started; happy to jump on a call if you want to walk the numbers.

Quick baseline (hosted API, list prices / per 1M tokens):
- Redwood-1-small (low-latency, cost-optimized): input $6.00 / 1M, output $10.00 / 1M
- Redwood-1-base (general purpose): input $9.00 / 1M, output $14.00 / 1M
- Redwood-1-pro (higher quality / context): input $18.00 / 1M, output $28.00 / 1M
- Open-LLama-3-xl (open model, compatible latency): input $7.50 / 1M, output $12.50 / 1M
- GPT-Compat-2-3B (small compat model for fast inference): input $4.50 / 1M, output $7.50 / 1M

Notes:
- Input = tokens in the prompt + system messages; Output = tokens generated by the model.
- For your prompt/output sizes (350 in / 220 out) the per-request IO cost is roughly (350/1e6)*input_rate + (220/1e6)*output_rate.
- Latency-sensitive production: Redwood-1-small and Redwood-1-base are recommended; Redwood-1-pro gives higher quality at higher cost.

I've attached: Redwood_Baseline_Ratecard_v1.pdf (list prices + model family notes) and Commit_Tier_Schedule.xlsx (discount bands).

Let me know if you want committed pricing or a dedicated pool quote — I can loop in our sales lead.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
Attach: Redwood_Baseline_Ratecard_v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
Attach: Commit_Tier_Schedule.xlsx (XLSX, 12KB)

--- Message 3 (follow-up from prospect) ---
From: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing inquiry — tokens, IO split and model roster

Ben — thanks, this is helpful. A couple quick follow-ups:
1) Do you offer volume discounts for committed monthly usage? If so, what are the thresholds?
2) We're also evaluating Dedicated (reserved GPUs) vs Hosted — do you have an enterprise-level baseline comparison (per-token hosted vs effective per-token on Dedicated after amortized GPU costs)?
3) Data residency & encryption at rest — we need SOC2 and customer-managed keys for production. Is this available on hosted?

If it helps, we're tentatively planning 30–60M tokens / month for the first 6 months if pilot goes well.

Thanks,
Sylvia

--- Message 4 (Ben loops in manager) ---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@clearpathhealth.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 12:35:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pricing inquiry — tokens, IO split and model roster

Forwarding Sylvia's follow-ups and our baseline — adding Laura Bennett from Sales Ops to outline commit discounts and Dedicated vs Hosted guidance. Laura — brief context above; ClearPath is a healthcare buyer looking at a 30–60M tokens/month pilot and needs SOC2 + CMK if possible.

--- On Sat, Nov 15, 2025 at 11:03 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote: ---
> [original baseline rates + attachments]

--- Message 5 (Sales ops reply) ---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@clearpathhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Nov 2025 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing inquiry — tokens, IO split and model roster

Hi Sylvia — Laura here (Sales Ops). Appreciate the details — below is a practical commit/discount table and quick guidance on Dedicated vs Hosted.

Commit discounts (hosted API, applied to list per-1M rates):
- 0–10M / month: list price (no discount)
- 10–50M / month: 10% off list
- 50–200M / month: 18% off list
- 200M+ / month: 28% off list (contact for enterprise pricing)

Dedicated (Reserved GPU) guidance:
- Dedicated can reduce effective per-token costs for steady-state, high-throughput workloads. Typical crossover point is ~150–300M tokens/month depending on model family and latency SLOs.
- For 30–60M/month a hosted commit is usually the faster, lower-risk path. We can size a Dedicated estimate if you expect growth >150M/month within 6–12 months.

Compliance & keys:
- SOC2 Type II is available for Hosted customers.
- Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and additional encryption controls are available on Redwood Private and on our Dedicated offering via a private control plane. We can discuss a SC-1 security addendum if necessary.

Next steps:
1) If you can confirm an expected monthly token band and target go-live date we can put a provisional commit on paper (non-binding) and give you a formal quote.
2) If you'd like a technical session on KMS/SOC2 we can set that with our Security team.

I'll drop a preliminary quote and an example commitment term in HubSpot. Ben — can you confirm whether ClearPath wants a 6- or 12-month commit?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sales Operations
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

--- Message 6 (prospect confirmation + question on SLA) ---
From: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Nov 2025 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing inquiry — tokens, IO split and model roster

Thanks Laura and Ben — that discount table is helpful. We expect to land ~50M tokens/month in month 1 of pilot (so the 10–50M band is likely, with a fast ramp to the 50–200M band if the pilot succeeds).

A couple final items before we loop procurement:
- Can you confirm the SLA for hosted API (availability, P99 latency targets for Redwood-1-small)?
- For SOC2 + CMK, will hosted require a provider-side add-on or do we need Redwood Private?

If those answers look good we'll share the ratecard internally and ask procurement to review the commit worksheet. Can we schedule a 30-min call early next week to finalize?

Appreciate it —
Sylvia
Director, Product
ClearPath Health
